product: AI chart analysis iOS app that reads a chart screenshot and returns trend, patterns, support/resistance, a Long/Short/Hold signal with entry, stop-loss and target, plus news sentiment

rules.tone: Relatable trading storytelling that moves from struggle to clarity without promising returns.

guidance.hook_style: First slide or first second is a strong emotional hook about trading pain
angles: trading with no plan, then finding clarity
show the app doing the work: upload chart, get signal, entry / SL / target
AI trading mentor for crypto, stocks, forex and commodities
notes: Video or native TikTok photo slideshow both accepted
5 to 10 slides performs best, do not overdo it
Real app footage converts better than mockups
For video posts show the app in the middle, not at the very end
Bio CTA required: 'Level up your trades with the TradeLens App' — may be reworded but must contain 'TradeLens App'
Minimum 1,000 views to qualify for payment
Submit within 30 minutes of posting with an analytics screenshot showing 40%+ Tier-1
Payments processed via Whop; campaign closes when budget is exhausted
